title: Orange Wallet
tagline: Our mission is to give access to faster cross-chain DeFi and a seemless NFT experience on mobile.
description:
Orange Wallet is the first and only Layer 2 focused non-custodial, decentralised crypto wallet.
Layer 2 Networks which are every day experiencing increasing footfall, Orange wallet can contribute to the numbers and users, it focuses specifically on providing the best user experience at Layer 2 network and it has extensive potential to bring more user base to Layer 2 and protocols based on it with a native mobile experience.
We are currently only supporting Polygon Network but we will be soon supporting other Layer 2 Networks as well.

Things you can do with Orange Wallet: 
1. Sending assets from one address to another. 
2. Depositing and withdrawing assets to and from Matic. 
3. Support for ERC20, ERC721, ERC1155. 
4. Staking Matic on Ethereum. 
5. Wallet Connect support for Polygon based Dapps. 
6. Fiat on Ramp via Transak. 
7. Encryption for mnemonic storage. 
8. DeFi like PoolTogether easily accessible within the app 
9. Yield Farming for various token.

Orange wallet is currently the official wallet for Kommunitas.net (decentralised and tier-less launchpad on polygon) and we have integration with PoolTogether (open source and decentralised protocol for no-loss prize games) and yield farming for various tokens.

We have also raised more than 40k USD in the form of Grants from Polygon, 
PoolTogether, Kommunitas and GitCoin GR10, we have around 400 contributors on GitCoin supporting our Project.

Orange wallet can be found on play-store at : https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=org.orange.wallet

And for iOS we are on beta testing, that can be joined from filling this form : https://forms.gle/KQt3LZVbisY12Fdd9
